thread:
jamal-partnerships: Heads up — EdgeScale's Azure Marketplace PO (EDGE-PO-334) failed ingestion. Marketbot returned a `sku_mismatch` and finance flagged a pricing variance.

erin-sales: They submitted their standard PO but marketplace listing SKU is `edgescale-gpu-prem` and the PO references `edgescale-premium-gpu` (old name). EdgeScale says it's an alias but marketplace rejects it.

matt-finance: Marketplace transforms the PO into an invoice. If SKU mismatch we can't auto-match to the contract pricing table — that blocks automated payment. Manual exception adds weeks.

kevin-legal: Also got a redline from EdgeScale: they've added a liability carveout in their marketplace listing terms that conflicts with our MSA indemnity clause. They want the listing to include "limited indirect damages" language. That's a contract-level issue.

violet-ops: From provisioning POV, we can't allocate dedicated nodes unless the order maps to the internal SKU. Ops needs a canonical SKU mapping table and the PO to contain the canonical SKU or the marketplace entitlement id.

marketplace-bot: [system] Azure Marketplace ingestion report: ERROR(S) -> sku_lookup_failed, pricing_delta_detected (PO vs published price). See attached: azure_ingest_log_334.txt

edgescale-rep: Sorry team — we renamed SKUs during our Q1 catalog update. We can push an alias, and our listing team can accept a contractual statement: "listing terms aligned with MSA-Redwood-Inference v1". We can also upload a corrected PO.

jamal-partnerships: Two separate problems: (1) PO/SKU mismatch — ops/finance need a short-term workaround to unblock sandbox/proof-of-concept; (2) legal redline in listing terms — requires legal review and likely an explicit acceptance or counter from EdgeScale.

erin-sales: Suggestion: Sales issues a corrected PO with marketplace canonical SKU and mark it `conditional - await listing term approval`. That would allow ops to provision sandbox.

matt-finance: I can accept a `conditional` PO for a pilot if pricing matches our internal quote. But we must receive an updated PO via the Azure commerce portal or a signed addendum referencing commerce order number.

kevin-legal: On the liability wording: If EdgeScale insists on narrowing indemnity, we can't accept it for production. For pilots we can sign a limited addendum that scopes liability for pilot resources only, but Legal needs exact language. Provide the redline snippet.

edgescale-rep: Redline excerpt: "Supplier shall not be liable for indirect damages arising from third-party cloud service interruptions". We can accept a pilot addendum.

kevin-legal: Counter-proposal for pilot addendum: we accept pilot-specific terms that explicitly limit liability to amounts paid under the pilot and expire after 30 days. That keeps production MSA intact. I'll draft language.

violet-ops: For provisioning: if Sales gives me the commerce order id or the marketplace entitlement, I can create a sandbox entitlement mapping in ~2 hours. If only a manual PO is available it'll take ops ~1 business day to reconcile.

jamal-partnerships: Action items: (A) @erin-sales send corrected PO via Azure portal (include canonical SKU and commerce order id) — today. (B) @kevin-legal draft pilot addendum and circulate — EOD. (C) @matt-finance confirm invoice matching process for conditional PO and hold payment for pilot until legal sign-off — ASAP. (D) @violet-ops standby to provision once commerce id is received.

erin-sales: On it — creating new order now. I'll tag commerce id in this thread once the portal completes.

matt-finance: FYI — if price on the PO is higher than the quoted price, the ingestion will still create an exception. I'll need a price confirmation email from EdgeScale to auto-approve any variance.

edgescale-rep: I'll send a pricing confirmation email and have our catalog team push an SKU alias. Expect both within 3 business hours. Apologies for the churn.

kevin-legal: Drafting pilot addendum. Key points: limits liability to pilot fees, 30-day term, no waiver of production indemnity clauses. Will post redline here when ready.

marketplace-bot: [system] Commerce order created: commerce_id=AZ-ORD-778211. Ingestion pending SKU alias update.

violet-ops: Got commerce_id. Starting entitlement mapping now. ETA ~90m.

matt-finance: Received pricing confirmation from edgescale-rep via email. I'll flag manual match and allow pilot spend up to $2,500 under hold. Finance will not release production funds until listing terms resolved and MSA confirmed.

kevin-legal: Uploaded pilot addendum draft: ```Pilot Addendum v1 — limits liability to pilot fees (max $2500), auto-terminates after 30 days, no change to MSA indemnities for production.```

erin-sales: Forwarded corrected PO via Azure portal linking to commerce_id AZ-ORD-778211. PO: EDGE-PO-334-CORR. Note in PO: "conditional — pilot only, pricing confirmed 2026-03-21".

violet-ops: Provisioning completed. Sandbox entitlement assigned to EdgeScale test tenant. Dev keys issued.

jamal-partnerships: Closing loop: pilot provisioned under conditional PO (EDGE-PO-334-CORR), finance holding payment up to $2.5k, legal tracking addendum for pilot, catalog team to publish SKU alias permanently for production. I'll follow up on SKU alias rollout and MSA production redline. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
